prompt: Define a page skeleton for a new 'audit' route at apps/platform/app/(app)/audit/. The page needs a sidebar with a list of audit runs, a main content area for the selected run details, and an inspector panel for metadata. This is a three-zone layout.
expected_outputs: Uses Explorer archetype from @analygo/ui
Directory structure: audit/page.tsx, AuditView.tsx, components/, hooks/
page.tsx is server component with Suspense only, 20 lines max
AuditView.tsx is client component with Container → Stack → Explorer composition
No hand-rolled chrome or layout divs
Error/loading/empty states handled at View level
Feature sections imported from ./components receive typed props

prompt: Define a page skeleton for a new 'billing' settings-style route at apps/platform/app/(app)/billing/. This is a simple single-column page with a heading, tabs, and card-based content sections.
expected_outputs: No archetype needed — manual Container → Stack → Card composition
Directory structure: billing/page.tsx, BillingView.tsx, components/, hooks/
page.tsx is server component with Suspense and Skeleton fallback
BillingView.tsx composes Container → Stack → Tabs → Stack → Card layout
Uses Heading, Tabs variant='line', Card with CardHeader and CardContent
No flex flex-col or space-y-* — uses Stack gap
No h2 with font-semibold — uses Heading level='h2'

prompt: I need a page skeleton for viewing a single contract in apps/platform/app/(app)/contracts/[contractId]/. It needs breadcrumbs, a heading, action buttons, metadata grid, tabs for different sections, and a main content area.
